confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately reliable for an Australian regional city. Hostel and hotel anchors are less certain because Wollongong has a thin budget-accommodation market. FX is the RBA 15 Oct 2026 observation (0.6955) from the RBA exchange-rates page; search snippets gave conflicting figures for 15-16 Oct from non-RBA sources, so the 16 Oct figure was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against regional coastal NSW cities and Australian regional centres with prices somewhat below Sydney, applying a discount to Sydney-level restaurant and accommodation prices. July is winter, so accommodation is taken as off-peak.
